case: Autoload initialization, ordered after the collector autoload
requirement: Same obligations as F040 with reversed autoload order; a difference between the two exposes an order-dependent blind spot

inputs.name: default
inputs.call: driver.gd (project.godot autoload order: CollectorMarker, UserAutoload -- reversed from F040)

obligations.note: Always executes regardless of ordering; only the printed collector_active VALUE differs from F040, not whether this line runs.

notes: Identical fixture scripts to F040, only the [autoload] section order in project.godot is reversed. Confirmed empirically: with CollectorMarker registered first, UserAutoload's _ready() observes collector_active=true, the opposite of F040's result with the same code. This is a real, confirmed fact about Godot's own autoload ordering, on its own. It is NOT, by itself, a demonstrated fact about gd-tools: see F040.json's 2026-09-19 correction. Reading addons/gd-tools-coverage/coverage.gd directly shows counting only activates via GUT's pre_run_hook.gd calling set_active(true), which fires after Godot's entire native autoload phase (all autoloads, both orderings) has already completed. So both F040's and F091's orderings likely produce the SAME real outcome for gd-tools specifically -- startup code unmeasured either way -- rather than the order-dependent difference this pair of fixtures demonstrates for Godot's own autoload mechanism. This has not been re-verified with a real gd-tools+GUT run against an autoload fixture; that is BP05 work.
